name: react-componets
description: A React and TypeScript playground for custom UI components

paragraphs: A React and TypeScript playground for custom UI components, video playback, and state-management experiments. Built for everyday development, learning, and testing—not a published component library.

React Components brings together small, source-level examples of React Context, MobX, a custom HTML5 video player, and CSS interaction effects. Use it to explore implementation patterns or as a starting point for your own experiments.

Project status: This is an experimental project on a legacy toolchain. The demo URL is configured in the repository; its current availability is not verified. Review the known limitations before using the code in a production application.
features: Custom video-player UI: playback controls, a progress bar, mute, playback-rate selection, fullscreen, picture-in-picture controls, gestures, loading states, and error feedback.
Video playback experiments: HTML5 video and HLS-related components built around React Context.
State-management examples: React Context providers and a MobX-backed counter.
Visual interactions: hover-to-play video previews, image effects, and a Swiper coverflow example.
Typed React source: TypeScript, CSS Modules, and route-level lazy loading.
